results.evidence: Tenet operates a Global Business Center in the Philippines with approximately 5,600 employees providing support across the enterprise. No material international revenue growth or expansion is disclosed in the filings.
No new subsidiary formation is disclosed in the filings. Tenet's structure remains consistent with Hospital Operations and Ambulatory Care segments.
No IPO or secondary equity offering is disclosed in the filings.

Tenet's revolving credit facility provides for floating-rate borrowings at SOFR plus applicable margin ranging from 1.25% to 1.50% per annum. At June 30, 2026, the company had no cash borrowings outstanding under the facility, but the facility itself carries floating-rate exposure when drawn.
results.verifiedQuote: Outstanding revolving loans under the 2025 Credit Agreement accrue interest at either (1) a base rate plus an applicable margin ranging from 0.25 % to 0.50 % per annum or (2) the Term Secured Overnight Financing Rate ("SOFR"), Daily Simple SOFR or the Euro Interbank Offered Rate ("EURIBOR") (each as defined in the 2025 Credit Agreement) plus an applicable margin ranging from 1.25 % to 1.50 % per annum

results.evidence: No material commodity or input-cost exposure is specifically disclosed in the risk factors or MD&A sections reviewed.
